name: Sippy Cups: Magic Adventures!
source:
Embark on an enchanting journey into a vibrant world filled with magic and mystery in "Sippy Cups: Magic Adventures!" Join Ava and Zoe, two adventurous toddlers, as they stumble upon whimsical items. Together, they'll uncover the secrets of the park In this heartwarming and imaginative game, players will be captivated by a charming storyline filled with unique characters and adorable creatures.

[Edited from [url=https://candelabella.itch.io/sippy-cups-magic-adventures]itch.io[/url]]
